description: Send a one-off test render of a campaign (with live rates and the org's branding) to the organization owner's email. Does not affect the campaign schedule.
name: send_test_campaign

outputSchema.description: Result of a single test send. The email goes to the organization OWNER's address, not to campaign recipients, and is capped at 3 per day per address.

message.description: Confirmation naming the address the test was sent to.

ok.description: True when the test email was accepted by the email provider.
